question.text: Once an investor is accredited at the time of onboarding into an AIF scheme, they:

answer.text: Must be re-accredited annually during the scheme's life
Shall be reckoned as an AI through the life of the scheme, even if they lose the status later
Must exit the scheme if their AI status lapses
Must convert to a non-AI investor class

explanation.text: The Logic: If an investor is an Accredited Investor at the time of onboarding into an AIF scheme, they are treated as an AI through the life of that scheme even if they lose the status in the interim. The Trap: The options requiring annual re-accreditation, exit, or class conversion do not match this onboarding-time rule. Note: Source page 72 of Series XIX-A AIF (Category I and II) Distributors workbook.
